description: The chart, labeled as Figure 2, represents the distribution of capabilities within the MULTITURNINSTRUCT dataset. The pie chart is divided into 9 slices, each representing a distinct capability. The slices are labeled with different capabilities, including Prioritization, Triggering, Personalization, Recursive Reasoning, Privacy Protection, Context Tracking, Dynamic Environment, Memorization, and Multitasking, as well as Context Retrieval and Dynamic Instruction, with some labels connected to their respective slices by lines. The approximate proportions of the slices are as follows: Prioritization (11%), Triggering (11%), Personalization (11%), Recursive Reasoning (12%), Privacy Protection (12%), Context Tracking and Context Retrieval together (12%), Dynamic Environment (11%), Memorization (11%), and Multitasking and Dynamic Instruction together (18%). The chart includes numerical labels adjacent to the capability names outside the pie chart, indicating the number of samples for each capability. The slices are colored differently, but the exact shades are not specified, and no legend is provided. The segments appear to be ordered in a clockwise direction, starting from Prioritization, but no particular pattern or emphasis is visually evident among the slices.
